Tier — Tier 1
Smallest volume bracket, highest unit price
Notes: Range varies by family; see Tier Definitions

Tier — Tier 2
Mid volume bracket, mid unit price
Notes: Range varies by family

Tier — Tier 3
Large volume bracket, lower unit price
Notes: Range varies by family

Tier — Tier 4
Very large volume bracket, lowest unit price
Notes: Only for high-volume items

Tier — Tier 5
Bulk bracket
Notes: Only for Pollen Basket UCCP

Tier — Single price
One price regardless of quantity
Notes: Common for cake boxes and pastry

Tier — Empty value (-)
Tier does not exist for that item
Notes: Product has fewer price brackets

Employee Rule — Reading SKUs
Family tells you category, supplier, and printer. Suffix tells you the specific item.
Notes: Training rule of thumb
